notes: Generated by internal/core/entities/catalogbuild. x/y/plane is the point of each location's infobox map (the center of its points), used to list the pending steps near the character. area is where a travel task ends (docs/10 section 7): the map's polygon (with its bounding box), its rectangle (rectX by rectY tiles around the point) or square (r tiles around it), else the box of 10 tiles around the point (from: point). Locations without a map, or whose map is an instance, are listed under unmapped and never placed.
